objective: Keep the portfolio's known blind spots measurable without confusing an honest diagnosis with closure.
invariants: A diagnostic pass means every blind spot has a current evidence-backed disposition; it does not mean every blind spot is closed.
The closure profile fails until all eight evaluations pass.
Missing human, visual-rights, production, or editorial evidence must remain missing rather than being inferred from proxy signals.
Archive completeness claims require a declared denominator, recovery method, and explicit gaps.
Strong mature claims must receive an editorial decision; maturity alone neither publishes nor buries them.

diagnostic.description: Pass when all eight blind spots are evaluated with valid statuses and non-empty evidence.

closure.description: Pass only when every blind spot is supported as closed by current evidence.

evaluations.title: Actual-work visual evidence
evaluations.blindSpot: A prose-heavy site can make built, spatial, technical, and relational work appear abstract.
evaluations.criterion: Every selected case study has rights-reviewed, public-safe, contextual visual evidence tied to claims, credits, and useful alt text.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Candidate-bound visual review covering all priority projects and at least twelve approved artifacts.

evaluations.title: Decisive hiring narrative
evaluations.blindSpot: Abundant evidence does not guarantee that a reader quickly understands Jamie's role, work, outcome, and fit.
evaluations.criterion: The current candidate passes role clarity, role fit, reader effort, Chad's lens, application path, and candidate-bound model review.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Current application-readiness report with the required scores and hard gates.

evaluations.title: Individual-role attribution
evaluations.blindSpot: Collective outcomes are better documented than Jamie's exact operational contribution to several high-value projects.
evaluations.criterion: Each named inquiry is either recovered or conclusively not recovered; partial and inconclusive records remain visibly open and unprojected.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Resolved inquiry records with source-backed role allocation or a documented final negative finding.

evaluations.title: Archive denominator integrity
evaluations.blindSpot: Authenticated platform views can be mistaken for immutable lifetime populations.
evaluations.criterion: Every declared social corpus records its recoverable population and explicitly states material historical, deletion, audience, authorship, or impact gaps.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Reviewed corpus records with population support and non-support boundaries.

evaluations.title: External human-reader validation
evaluations.blindSpot: Deterministic and LLM judges can form a closed evaluation loop that misses real hiring-reader behavior.
evaluations.criterion: At least five target-role readers evaluate the exact candidate using the same bounded comprehension and interview-interest tasks.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Candidate-bound, anonymized aggregate study evidence with no raw participant data.

evaluations.title: Change reviewability
evaluations.blindSpot: A coherent knowledge graph can still arrive in a pull request too large for confident human review.
evaluations.criterion: The branch stays within review thresholds or is split into independently reviewable units with explicit human approval.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Git diff statistics within threshold or an approved decomposition record.

evaluations.title: Production release evidence
evaluations.blindSpot: Application readiness does not establish deployed-SHA, smoke, rollback, indexing, or approval readiness.
evaluations.criterion: The exact reviewed and deployed commit matches and production smoke, rollback, indexing, staging noindex, and human approval attestations all pass.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Explicit release attestations bound to the exact Git commit.

evaluations.title: Strong-claim promotion discipline
evaluations.blindSpot: Public-safety caution can silently become self-erasure when mature unused claims never receive an editorial decision.
evaluations.criterion: Every mature unused claim has a recent candidate-bound promote, defer, or not-for-current-purpose decision with a rationale.
evaluations.closureEvidence: Complete editorial decision coverage for the current mature-unused claim set.
